description:
## 1.2.0 (2026-10-30)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* complete reader access and enable built-in ad-free rendering 9319515
* **dev:** restore the patch catalog after the version bump 031eb30
* **mit-review:** mark the verified 3.0 target supported 0903045
* select the declared bundle when generating the patch catalog 41e7e15

### ✨ New Features

* add experimental MIT Tech Review reading meter patch b75bf34
* **remote-atv:** replace premium offers with ad-free status 36550b9

patches.name: Emby client unlock
patches.description: Enables local in-app feature gates using Kirlif's observed approach. Does not grant server Premiere entitlements.

patches.name: Emby remove Firebase and DataTransport
patches.description: Removes Firebase/DataTransport SDK classes and manifest components. Disables Firebase push messaging; keeps Cast and billing libraries.

patches.name: MIT Tech Review reading meter
patches.description: Removes local article gates and the remaining-views banner, and enables the app's ad-free flag for native and article ads. Keeps account authentication; does not grant a server subscription.

patches.name: Disable analytics collection
patches.description: Disables declared analytics and crash collection and removes advertising permissions. Keeps Firebase Messaging and location permissions. Does not guarantee zero tracking.

patches.name: Local lists and backups
patches.description: Adds BadFella Settings with 299 or 900 local lists, local task assignments, and manual or scheduled local backups of organization and supported task snapshots. Cloud lists and task ownership stay in TickTick; attachment file contents are not included.

patches.name: Restore notifications
patches.description: Restores Firebase certificate metadata on re-signed apps, with an Android 17 compatible token setup. Push delivery still requires device testing.

patches.name: Restore reminder alarms
patches.description: Restores task/reminder alarm scheduling on re-signed apps.

patches.name: TickTick Premium
patches.description: Enables client-side premium features and limits. Does not grant server-side AI access or a subscription.

patches.name: Remote ATV ad-free
patches.description: Disables advertising, restores startup and replaces premium activation with a local ad-free status. Hides the English home announcement. Does not create a server subscription.

release_notes:
Remote ATV: hides the English home announcement and opens an ad-free status dialog from Settings instead of subscription offers.

MIT Technology Review: adds the tested 3.0 reading and ad-free patches.

TickTick and Emby patches are included.

Refresh the BadFella Patches source in Morphe Manager, then patch the original app again using your existing signing key.
repoDescription: BadFella Patches - community patches for Morphe Manager.
